book.name: 2Qorontoose Asaas
book.title: Phawuloosi Qorontoose Asaas Xaafida Nam7anththo Kiita

content: Maado Imo
Ta ishatoo! Xoossi Maqidooniyan diza ammaniza asaas immida kiyateththaa intte erana mala ta koyays.
Istti daro metoti dishe daro ufayettida; keehi manqota gidikkoka daro kiyattida.
Istti baas dandayettizayssa malanne baas dandayettizayssafekka aaththi immidayssa ta istta gishshas markkattays.
Yuhudan diza ammanizaytas maado immanaas digettontta mala nuna keehi woossida.
Istti nuni qoppidayssafe bollara aaththi ooththida; istti koyro bana Godaas immida; zaaridikka Xoossa shene mala banakka nuus immida.
Hayssa oosoza koyro Titoosi doommida gishshas ha7ikka hayssa maado imoza izi polana mala nu iza woossidos.
Intte ammanon, haasayan, erateththan, mino ooson, intte nuna siiqiza siiqon, ubba yo7on aadhdheeta; hessaththoka kiyateththa oosonkka aadhdhizayta gidite.
Ta hessa gizay inttena coo mela azazanaas gidenna; gido attiin hankko hara asay minni immizayssa inttenara gaththa beyishin intte siiqoy tumu gididayssa shaakka eranaassa.
Intte nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa kiyateth ereeta.
Hayssa ha hanozan taas lo7o gidi beettida zore ta inttes immays; zilayth intte imo xalla gidontta dishin immanaas koyroppe qoppiday inttena.
Hessa gishshas intte immanaas koyidayssi polettana mala inttes diza mala kase intte qoppidayssa ha7i ooththite.
Asi immanaas wozinappe koykko izaadey kiyateththan immizayssi ekettizay asi baas dizaari mala immiko attiin baas bayndayssafe immishin gidenna.
Ta hayssaththo gizay intte wurikka gina gidana mala attiin intte imon waayettishin harati shempana mala gaada gidenna.
Intte waayettishin istta miishshay intte meto ashshana mala ha7i qasse intte miishshay istta meto ashsho; hessa malan intte giddon ginateththi daana.
Hessika, «Daro shiishshidaades wodhdhibeenna; guuth shiishshidaadeska paccibeenna» geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettida mala.
Titoosanne Iza Laggeta
Tani inttes qoppizayssa mala Titoosaykka inttes wozinappe qoppana mala ooththida Goday galatetto.
Titoosi intteko bizay barkka ba qofan ufayssanppe attiin nuni iza woossida gishshas xalla gidenna.
Mishiraachcho qaala ooson Woosa Keeththatan ubbaan dosettida ishaza nu izara gaththi yeddoos.
Hessafekka bollara hayssi nu ishay nuni hayssa lo7o oosoza Godaa bonchchos ooththishininne nuni ooththanaas koyzayssa izas qonccisishin izi nunara biidi ooththanaas Woosa Keeththati dooridaade.
Hayssa kiyateth imettida miishshaza nuni oykkishin nu bolla aykko boroykka gakkontta mala nuni naagettoos.
Gaasoykka nuus waanna qofay Godaa sinththan xalla gidontta asa sinththankka lo7o ooththanaassa.

Daro wode daro miishshan paacettidi mino gidida nu ishaa Titoosara nu iza yeddiday hessassa; izas intte bolla diza ammanoy daro gita gidida gishshas izi ha7i inttena maaddanaas kaseppe aaththi koyees.
Intte Titoosa gishshas eranaas koykko izi inttena maaddanaas tanara ooththizaade; izara issife biza hankko ishati qasse Woosa Keeththati ba gishshas yeddida Kirstoosa bonchchos eqqidayta.
Hessa gishshas intte isttas intte siiqo bessite; intte hessaththo histtiko intte siiqoynne nu inttenan ceeqettiza ceeqeteththi coo hada gidonttayssa intte Woosa Keeththatas bessandeta.
